abstract: Builds an evidence-cited ([C]/[I]/[U]-tagged) architecture documentation corpus — a platform README, one doc per repo or workspace package, and a machine-parseable dependency graph — from static analysis across multiple sibling repositories, including repos that are themselves pnpm/turbo/Nx/Cargo/Go workspaces with several independently addressable packages. Unlike microservice-docs, which documents one service from prescriptive templates, this skill covers a multi-repo fleet and grades every claim by evidence quality.
